description: This Java configuration class sets up a batch job for updating email outbound messages with campaign messages in the Apache Fineract platform. It defines beans for a step, a job, and a tasklet that together facilitate processing of email campaigns related to client communication.

classes.name: UpdateEmailOutboundWithCampaignMessageConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class defining a batch job for processing email campaign messages to outbound recipients.

methods.name: updateEmailOutboundWithCampaignMessageStep
methods.description: Defines the batch processing step that executes the tasklet for updating email outbound messages with campaign messages.

methods.name: updateEmailOutboundWithCampaignMessageJob
methods.description: Creates the batch job which includes the processing step and an incrementer for unique job runs.

methods.name: updateEmailOutboundWithCampaignMessageTasklet
methods.description: Provides the tasklet bean that encapsulates the logic for updating email outbound messages with campaign data.
